title: Point the AGENTS.md managed block at the one rules file
description: Agent judgment now lives in docs/public/agents/rules.md, with Claude-only steps in docs/public/agents/claude.md, and the twelve per-operation rule files no longer ship. The AGENTS.md managed block still has an Operation homes list naming those retired files, so an installed agent reads names that resolve to nothing. Desired: replace that list with one pointer to .yoke/docs/agents/rules.md. Until the managed block changes and a refreshed install ships it, the project-native surface stays current-state only.
